title: Synthetic vendor screening
description: Invented vendor-screening policy for Study 009's constructed existence witness: route a vendor to clear, manual review, or reject from a sanctions flag and a risk score. Synthetic content for a study fixture; it authorizes nothing.

decision.intent: Screen a vendor into exactly one outcome from its sanctions flag and risk score.
decision.question: Is this vendor cleared, sent to manual review, or rejected?

sources.title: Example vendor screening standard (POLICY.md)

citation.excerpt: P1: a sanctions hit is rejected regardless of score. P2: absent a sanctions hit, a risk score of 70 or above goes to manual review. P3: absent a sanctions hit, a risk score below 70 is cleared.

sources.rights: Invented content for a study fixture; not an operational policy.

outcomes.label: Clear
outcomes.description: No sanctions hit and the risk score is below the review threshold.

outcomes.label: Manual review
outcomes.description: No sanctions hit and the risk score is at or above the review threshold.

outcomes.label: Reject
outcomes.description: A sanctions hit, regardless of score.

rules.description: A sanctions hit is rejected regardless of score.
Absent a sanctions hit, a risk score of 70 or above goes to manual review.
Absent a sanctions hit, a risk score below 70 is cleared.
